limits: Gaussian smoothing of sampled flower counts, within meadow only, normalized to observed grids; not seed flux, hydrodynamic or realized dispersal kernel. Kernel bandwidth is a scenario, not fitted dispersal distance; 150m chosen as central approximation to published indirect genetic estimate, not equivalent quantity.

Height is measured vegetation height averaged within matched quadrats then grids, and canopy=vegetative count times height is proxy, not drag, cover, trapping or animal abundance. Biomass is observed but not seed capture. Same year and four meadows; dependent nested sample, response-open diagnostic and no external validation.

Neighbor flower counts are allowed at withheld meadow, since entire predictor survey is observed; no held-out seed counts used for training. Excluding high-count grid from outcome fit leaves its measured flowering covariates in smoothing; response-open sensitivity.
No causal claim that physical retention or immigration drives prediction, no source or sink designation; original seedTF label discrepancies retained. No animal data.
